trap.label: get over
trap.wrong: She got over to lose the game.
trap.right: She got over losing the game.
trap.why: Em português “superar perder” aceita infinitivo. Em inglês, get over é verbo preposicionado; o que segue é substantivo ou -ing, nunca to.

fix.wrong: I got over of my fear.
I get over to it yesterday.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com -ing: “He got over (lose) his job.”
rewrite.answer: He got over losing his job.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com it: “I got over the quarrel.”
Reescreva no passado: “She gets over her fear.”
